name: Villard Houses

location.text: 451 Madison Avenue, New York, New York

dates.note: Wikipedia infobox 'Built 1882-1884'; the node's exemplar says 1884 and its prose dates the design to 1882.

refs.title: Villard Houses, 451-457 Madison Avenue & 24 East Fifty-first Street, New York County, NY
refs.note: The search result's own line: 'Survey number: HABS NY-5635'. The data PDF, read by extract the same day, is an inventory of 1977 photogrammetric stereopairs ('10 2.25" x 2.25" glass plate negatives (5 stereopairs) Produced by Perry E. Borchers of the Ohio State Univeristy') and says 'Data page 1 was previously transmitted to the Library of Congress. This is data page 2.' -- it carries no descriptive text, so no survey block is recorded.
The item record lists a 'pdf version of data pages [130kb]' and 35 sheets of measured drawings.

refs.title: HABS NY,31-NEYO,120- (sheet 1 of 35) - Villard Houses, 451-457 ...
refs.note: The sheet's own caption: 'Appearing as a single Italian palazzo, the Villard Houses were actually six residences built around a central courtyard by architects, McKim, Mead and White.'

refs.title: NRHP reference No. 75001210; added September 2, 1975; NYSRHP No. 06101.004572; NYCL No. 0268-0270, designated September 30, 1968 (as the Wikipedia infobox prints it)
refs.note: Read from the infobox, not from the National Register's own database.

refs.title: Villard Houses - Wikipedia
refs.note: 'The archdiocese hired William Shopsin in January 1976 to conduct a historical survey of the Villard Houses. Shopsin recorded the buildings' architectural details for the Historic American Buildings Survey.'

note: The Library holds 35 measured sheets for this building and the written data that reached us is a plate inventory; the dimensions live on the sheets, which this container cannot open. The Wikipedia article states a frontage of 60 ft on Madison Avenue and 74 ft on 51st Street for the lot under 457 Madison, which is a lot and not the building. Seeded 4 Sep 2026.
